assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read in full with its front matter: the canonical v1.0 standalone literary monograph SHIBOYUGI_SHIRO_MONOGRAPH.md (SBY-P054), repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main narratives and original visual layers of SBY-JP-V01-W01 through SBY-JP-V10-W01, located by spine member and paragraph, with route evidence from V05 and V07-V10. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Shiro across her located appearances in story order rather than disclosure order: the football career that ends after she beats a coach, and her first game, Underrealm, after which she pursues her family papers and wakes before Kūron (recollections disclosed in V05, V08 and V10); the Royal Palace performer and tactician in V05; the Mine Forest conversation in V07 (Yūki's #66); the Mikkai house, the recruitment of Yūki, the Awahime dispute and the succession-reward call in V08-V09; and V10, from Airi's reception through Jamboree Ship (Yūki's #93), her intervention for Airi, the break with Maguma, the pursuit and the bounded last sighting. V08-V09 Mikkai Shiro and V10 Shiro under pressure in a lethal game are separate capability states. The boundary limits evidence, not her knowledge: her childhood, the coach and Kūron's genealogical account belong to her at every state they predate.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph states a mechanism and conditions it: she recruits by recognizing what makes a person good at something and offering a specific inducement toward a purpose she already values; a refused promise sends her toward further evidence or another candidate; an explicit obstacle (strong refusal, imminent harm to a key prospective ally, contrary institutional information) redirects rather than intensifies her; and when another person's control of valuable material conflicts with her entitlement and the organization's benefit, her proven conduct is to bypass consent and obscure her responsibility (V08 S16/S18/S20, V09 S16/S21/S26). It adds her own account of herself as 餓鬼 and the calm and pleasure in violence that frighten her (V08 S20). Not B: the monograph says its strongest prediction is conditional on the goal and the person she thinks she can still use or keep, and that it cannot say what she does when the interests of a person and the value of the project actually diverge; at the V10 intervention she may be guarding Airi, the project or both (V10 S23). Not D: the conditions are located and predict both her inducements and her coercion.

The states are located: the football career that collapses after she beats the coach, Underrealm and the turn to family papers, the sedation and Kūron's genealogy (V05 S21, V08 S20, V10 S16); the V05 performer who exploits Tamamo's information; the V07 Mine Forest report of the tiebreak; V08-V09 Mikkai Shiro with house, recruitment, dispute and reward; and V10 Shiro organizing at sea, intervening, pursued and alone (V10 S16/S19/S21/S23). Not B: V06 is absent, the early states are recollections whose recurrences vary, and the development between V05 and V08 is not traced. Not D: each state carries located conduct and the transitions in V08-V10 are given reasons.

Written Japanese register is analyzed by audience and function: 「いやあ、失敬」 and 「とんだご無礼。お許しください」 enlarging a lapse into staged deference; 「どうぞお見知り置きを」 before exploiting a known impairment (V05 S21); 「……わかる？」 and 「ちょっと強引に迫りすぎたかなあ……」 as private access with Maya (V08 S16); 「これは当然の処置だ。通すべき筋を通しているだけです」 making a judgment sound like propriety; 「この度は、ご迷惑をおかけして申し訳ございません」 as an apology that leaves out the history; 「あなたの後継者となるのは」 to Kūron (V08 S20); 「撃つな！」 and 「必ず、殺してやる」 (V10 S21/S23). Not B: about nine forms in six situations, no general politeness or self-reference rule, and the monograph says the print does not specify a performed voice. Not D: each form is tied to an audience and a function.

Only local items: a person on hand to open the door, rooms for members, family reading material within reach, a taco dinner where she invites Kokone to the sixth chair and prompts her to eat, lying awake and taking an early-morning walk, close attention to her costume in V05 (V08 S16/S18/S20, V05 S21). The monograph itself says this is more secure than any regular diet, leisure schedule or emotional diagnosis. Not D: the items come from a few scenes, with no account of ordinary choices.

Her stance differs by partner, with located reasons: Maya gets informal answers, closeness and self-assessment, and is also called a sample in a pitch (V08 S16/S18); Kokone is a paid specialist whose skills and phone she uses; Takami and Busutake are recognized resources, and Takami can correct her (V08 S18/S20, V10 S23); Awahime moves from invited collaborator to someone she harms, discredits and sets terms for (V08 S20); Yūki gets formal recognition, a released request and an apology that withholds the commission (V05 S21, V08 S20); Kūron gets acknowledgment of his standing and a refusal to cede the prize; Yukariko sets terms Shiro complies with because she has what Shiro wants (V10 S16); Maguma becomes the target of her accusation after firing (V10 S23). Not B: most partners appear in one or two scenes, and the monograph leaves open what she does for an ally when the ally and the project separate. Not D: the differences are located and partly explained by use, control and purpose.

Narrated interior is located: 餓鬼 as her one-word account of herself, the calm she found in violence and the pleasure in killing that frighten her, the denial of an embarrassment she seems to feel before Kūron (V08 S20); lying awake after a failed approach (V08 S20); resentment at the pursuers who turn her work into a reason to punish her, lashing out she cannot explain, and the last perception that no remembered face comes to mind (V10 S23). Not B: the monograph keeps Takami's theory of what she can feel as a third person's model, leaves her reaction to Maya's body open between generous and hostile readings (V10 S21), and says the last scene cannot settle her past attachments. Not D: these are her own narrated states, not only others' reports.

Conflict conduct is located and includes her mistakes: in V05 she takes an opening a team decision leaves and uses Tamamo's private information; in the Awahime dispute she rejects settlement, commissions an attack expecting Awahime to be killed, repeatedly tries to recall it on learning Yūki is at risk and orders withdrawal after harm is done (V08 S20); at sea she organizes, misreads the 47-of-48 count, underrates Yūki's ability to continue, directs a search when the institution declines to finish and defers to a teammate's account after the flood (V10 S19/S21); she shouts 撃つな！, stops others following Airi's call, turns on Maguma and fires back at pursuers until out of ammunition (V10 S23). Not B: emergency thresholds and her conduct when an ally and the project diverge are not established. Not D: the repertoire and its errors are located.

The row claims ETHICS. What is located is conduct and justification, not deliberation: she circulates a derived version of Awahime's technique over a recollected promise of exclusivity, frames her choice of a commission over settlement as propriety (これは当然の処置だ), apologizes to Yūki while withholding the commission and using a partial truth to hide a later dispute (V08 S20), and frames Maguma's shot as firing at an ally after Airi had designated herself an allowable cost (V10 S23). The archival meeting is the located exception where she complies with another's terms (V10 S16). Not C: no weighing of alternatives is shown, and the monograph treats her V10 protection as either protection or refusal of a stated choice. Not E: the justification pattern recurs across two linked sequences and one exception.

One local item: she enlarges an ordinary lapse in the dressing area into a deliberate scene of deference with 「とんだご無礼。お許しください」 (V05 S21). Not D: the monograph does not analyze play or humor as a pattern.

The portrait routes every material claim to spine and paragraph locators across her appearances in V05 and V07-V10, separates recollection, others' reports and narrated action as different kinds of evidence, and keeps unresolved items open (her clear count, the DVD's contents, her final outcome). The project routes it complete at the V10 boundary, and its retrospective audit records PASS standalone and PASS Japanese fidelity. Not A: it is one literary portrait with no curated model, ledger or check on this subject, and the source withholds her fate and the archive's contents. Not C: coverage of her appearances is complete for the declared boundary.

Affirmative evidence of her limits and mistakes: she misses teammates' calls while absorbed in her costume (V05 S21); she may have pressed Yūki too hard, by her own assessment (V08 S16); she fails to retain several new introductions when she needs them, underrates Yūki's ability to continue and misreads the 47-of-48 count (V10 S16/S19); her V08 interior gives 32 clears against her at-sea statement and Airi's estimate of about forty (V08 S20, V10 S19); no #99, appointment or share has occurred, and Kūron's genealogy is never independently confirmed (V08 S20, V10 S16); the DVD is not played (V10 S16). Not A: the evidence does not explain the gaps it marks. Not C: these are located findings, not inferences from silence.

Claims are placed by volume, spine and paragraph, story order is separated from disclosure order (V09 S16 recovers part of a call Yūki heard in V08; the coach and Underrealm are recollections disclosed in V05, V08 and V10), and the monograph keeps what Shiro knows apart from what others privately intend (Kokone, Yukariko). Not A: the early states are undated recollections whose recurrences vary, and the V05-V08 interval is not traced. Not C: the V05, V07, V08-V09 and V10 states are located.

conditions: Illustrative written-Japanese lines only, never presented as quotation.

Register limited to the sampled situations: staged courtesy before an audience or a rival in a game (V05), private informal talk with Maya (V08), propriety framing among Mikkai members, a formal apology to Yūki that omits history, acknowledgment of Kūron's standing, and a terse command in an armed emergency (V10).
No performed voice, no extended casual conversation, no intimate register beyond the located lines with Maya, and no line that settles her motive by honorifics alone.
scenario_readiness.note: The audience-conditioned forms constrain short written lines in the sampled situations enough for illustrative use. Not READY: about nine located forms and no general register rule. Not NOT_READY: each form is tied to an audience and a function across several scenes.

conditions: Source-near counterfactuals that change one located element (a prospect's answer, an offer of information, who controls valuable material) and state the change.

Predict her method at moderate confidence: a specific inducement and a follow-up opening for a capable prospect; a refused promise leading to further evidence or another candidate; redirection, not escalation, at an explicit obstacle; bypassing consent and obscuring responsibility, framed as propriety, when another person's control of valuable material conflicts with her entitlement; compliance when a counterparty has what she wants and sets the terms.
Include her predicted errors: pressing a prospect too hard, underrating another player, misreading counts or game structure, and forgetting new introductions under pressure.
When protecting a person and advancing the project diverge, give an open fork, never a single prediction.
Attribute behavior to the selected state: V08-V09 Mikkai conduct does not transfer automatically to V10 conduct in a lethal game, or the reverse.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One selected state: V08-V09 Mikkai Shiro (house, recruitment of Yūki, the Awahime dispute and the succession-reward call), or V10 Shiro from Airi's reception through Jamboree Ship up to the pursuit. She knows Kūron's genealogical account without independent confirmation, knows the reported #99 terms she has cross-checked, and does not know Yukariko's private reasons or Kokone's wish that the bid fail.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Maya, Takami, Busutake and Kokone as Mikkai members; Yūki, Maguma and Airi as prospects or partners; Awahime as an estranged collaborator; Kūron as the institutional head she means to succeed; Yukariko as a counterparty who sets terms. Her family, the coach and the scout who brought her to the games are unsampled; a comparable prospect or member is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: The Mikkai house or a comparable private recruitment conversation, a direct meeting with the institution, an archival exchange, or an in-game team setting run by the same organizers.

No held #99, appointment or exercise of office, no life after V10 or confirmed fate, no football or family scene, no cross-series setting, and no change to the industry's rules without a stated assumption.

scenario_readiness.note: The recruitment, redirection and coercion conditions support narrow extrapolation near the sampled scenes. Not READY: what she does when an ally and the project diverge, and her emergency thresholds, are open. Not NOT_READY: the conditions and her predicted errors recur with located outcomes.

Ordinary life is a dinner, a sleepless night and a morning walk, and the monograph says these are more secure than any regular diet, leisure schedule or emotional diagnosis. This bounds use and is not a finding about her ordinary life.

known_limits.statement: At the V10 confrontation Shiro may be guarding Airi, the project or both, and the monograph says there is no secure evidence of what she would do if a person and the project were decisively separable. A model cannot say which motive decides for an ally when they diverge.

After seeing Maya's displayed body, Takami sees Shiro's face briefly blank and then hears rage and a promise to kill Yūki; Takami's reading is a third person's model, and generous and hostile possibilities occupy the same scene.

No #99 under these arrangements, appointment or equal share has occurred within the horizon, Kūron's genealogical claim is never independently confirmed, and an invitation would not show how she would negotiate, share or consolidate power. A model must not invent her conduct in office.
The last scene shows her alone in the medical room holding her remaining armed grenade; no final physical outcome or later identification is displayed, and her survival status stays open.
Her V08 interior gives 32 clears, at sea she says she plays the minimum, and Airi estimates about forty. A model must not state one count as settled.
The beating of the coach is located, but the narrator gives no verified legal or medical disposition, and the dreamed victims of its recurrences are not all the same person.
The DVD she receives from Yukariko is not played, its content and payment are unconfirmed, and her knowledge of Yukariko's reasons and later withholding is unestablished.
Family relationships, diet, routine, any sporting life after the coach, and experience beyond the story's few domestic glimpses are not evidenced.
Only written Japanese register is available; pitch, accent and extended ordinary conversation are not evidenced.

The curated evidence is one literary monograph over a limited set of located scenes; no operational model, decision ledger or model check is curated on this subject, so the narrow conditional predictions rest on one line of evidence.
